# Test Case Generator Ai MCP

> Test case generation and coverage analysis by MEOK AI Labs

`test-case-generator-ai-mcp` is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server by MEOK AI Labs.

## Install

```bash
pip install test-case-generator-ai-mcp
```

Or run without installing:

```bash
uvx test-case-generator-ai-mcp
```

## Tools

- `generate_test_cases` — Generate test cases for a function based on its signature and parameter types.
- `generate_edge_cases` — Generate edge cases and boundary conditions for a function.
- `generate_test_matrix` — Generate a combinatorial test matrix from parameter value sets.
- `assess_coverage` — Assess test coverage gaps for a function given existing test descriptions.
